lista.descripcion: Baycurrent Classic, First Round | The Round 1 stroke play of the 2026 Baycurrent Classic takes place at Yokohama Country Club. This event is part of the PGA Tour's FedExCup Fall series. Xander Schauffele enters the week as the defending champion who won $1,440,000 in 2025.
